fields.description: Palmiera 3 is a four-bedroom villa collection at The Oasis, planned around water, greenery and shared recreation. Three exterior designs give the phase a varied streetscape. Emaar presents the homes as family residences with a close connection to gardens and the surrounding public landscape.

overview: A community centre, gym and shared leisure spaces are part of Palmiera 3’s planned setting. Water and planted routes are intended to link everyday recreation with the homes. The floor plans show a guest suite downstairs, family bedrooms on the first floor and a lounge with terrace on the second floor.
research.locationNote: Palmiera 3 sits within The Oasis, Dubai. Emaar describes connections through Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Road (D54) and a future Al Khail Road (E44) extension. Treat proposed links as planned infrastructure and check current access from the actual villa.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 9.18m. The launch sheet lists Classic from AED 9.18m, Contemporary from AED 9.32m and Chamfer from AED 9.66m. These are launch references, not current stock quotations.
research.paymentNote: The official launch sheet specifies 10% initially, seven further 10% instalments and 20% on completion. Dates below belong to the August 2024 release.
research.handoverNote: October 2028 is the launch estimate, also reported by Property Finder. Confirm the current sale agreement and construction position.

facts.label: Launch mix
facts.value: 59 villas: 20 Classic, 21 Contemporary and 18 Chamfer. This is phase scale, not remaining inventory.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Published totals include terrace, carport and driver’s room in addition to the three floors. They are not plot areas.

facts.label: Layout details
facts.value: Plans show a lift, two kitchens, maid’s room, laundry, storage, driver’s accommodation and roof lounge. All three sheets identify the private pool as owner-provided.

facts.label: Document identity
facts.value: The developer’s brochure download is a one-page fact sheet with unit mix and payment dates.
